title: English Practice Quiz 0829
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.
